findings.detail: Amazon EKS ended standard support for Kubernetes 1.34 on 2026-12-02 and extended support on 2027-12-02. Extended support is on by default and billed per cluster-hour.
findings.remediation: Upgrade the control plane to a Kubernetes minor that is still in standard support.
findings.title: Kubernetes 1.34 is out of Amazon EKS support (extended support ended 2027-12-02)
